t: Heavy duty, die-cast metal and engineered nylon plasterboard fixings. Easy to install with a screwdriver, with no pre-drilling required. Drilling wings cut through plasterboard and open to grip behind it, offering secure holding power. Suitable for mounting TV brackets, bathroom fixtures, curtains, cabinets, shelves and heavy mirrors. Includes M5 machine screws.
b: Suitable for Hanging Radiators, Kitchen Cabinets & TV Mounting
